sourceOfTruth.primaryOutcome: A resumable Obsidian course vault containing an index, per-lesson notes, timestamped transcripts, key frames, review material, and a manifest.

risks: The frozen bibigpt-deploy root still has a live Vercel binding and must not be used.
Bilibili subtitle and media availability may vary and can require a session token.
Browser-local Whisper speed and memory use depend on the client device.
The API key previously exposed in chat must be rotated before another real-provider run.
YouTube captionless fallback is optional and not part of the accepted Bilibili-focused delivery.
